{"id":1565096685,"question_id":3227,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1741280120,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"12 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1565096685/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find Missing and Repeated Values","memory":"31.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> findMissingAndRepeatedValues(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        vector<int>ans(2);\n        unordered_map<int,int>mapping;\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n\n        for(int i= 0; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ;j++)\n            {\n                mapping[grid[i][j]]++;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        for(int i =1; i<=n*m ;i++)\n        {\n            if(mapping[i] == 2)\n            ans[0] = i;\n\n            if(mapping[i] == 0)\n            ans[1] = i;\n        }\n        return ans;\n        \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-missing-and-repeated-values","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":418}
